title: Outback Sunrise
description: Acrylic on canvas, 100x75cm. Framed. This vibrant piece captures the essence of dawn breaking over the Australian outback, featuring traditional Aboriginal-inspired concentric circles representing connection to country.

title: Desert Dreaming
description: Mixed media on canvas, 75x100cm. Unframed. A vertical composition inspired by the flowing rivers and ancient pathways of the Australian desert landscape.

title: Spirit of the Land
description: Oil on canvas, 90x90cm. Framed in native timber. A powerful representation of the sun spirit radiating energy across the ochre landscape.

title: Ochre Sunset
description: Acrylic on canvas, 120x67cm. Panoramic piece capturing the stunning colours of an outback sunset with silhouetted native trees.

title: Sacred Waterhole
description: Mixed media on canvas, 80x80cm. Framed. Depicts a sacred waterhole surrounded by traditional dot work patterns and animal tracks.

title: Uluru Dreams
description: Oil on canvas, 100x75cm. Framed. A night scene featuring Uluru under the Southern Cross, blending traditional and contemporary styles.
